channel.description: Latest articles from God Updates (Salem Web Network) (godupdates.com)

item.title: Baby Boy Born in a Carl's Jr. Parking Lot After Parents Didn't Make it to the Hospital On Time
item.description: When labor moved faster than expected, new parents welcomed their baby boy in an unexpected place—a Carl’s Jr. parking lot. With help from first responders, the surprise arrival turned into a moment they’ll never forget.

item.title: Diagnosed With Bone Cancer, Young Soldier Reunites With the Dog He Loved Overseas
item.description: After being diagnosed with bone cancer, a young soldier found comfort and strength in an emotional reunion with the dog he bonded with while serving overseas. Their reunion brought healing, hope, and a reminder of unconditional love.

item.title: Born in the Middle of World War I, This 108-Year-Old is Still Going Strong
item.description: Born in the middle of World War I, this remarkable 108-year-old has lived through more than a century of history and change. Even now, they continue to inspire others with resilience, wisdom, and a joyful spirit.

item.title: The Power of Your Mouth
item.description: This article explores the biblical truth that our words carry the power to shape hearts, relationships and spiritual environments, illustrating how spoken life—or silence—can profoundly affect others. Through Scripture, personal stories and the imagery of sowing seeds and prayerful “superblooms,” it encourages choosing words that plant life and trusting God to bring the harvest in His time.

item.title: Brave Father Runs Back Into Burning Home to Rescue His Daughter From House Fire
item.description: When a house fire broke out, a brave father didn’t hesitate—running back inside the flames to rescue his daughter. His fearless act turned a terrifying night into a story of love and heroism.

item.title: Siblings Are Heroes After Saving Their Bus Driver and Keeping the Other Kids Calm
item.description: When a bus driver suddenly faced a medical emergency, a group of siblings stepped in without hesitation to help. Their calm actions and quick thinking turned a frightening moment into a story of young heroes.

item.title: Finding Love Again at 78, This Loving Couple Met at Church and Married Four Months Later
item.description: At 78, she wasn’t expecting love to find her again—but a chance meeting at church changed everything. Just four months later, the couple said “I do,” proving it’s never too late for a beautiful new beginning.

item.title: Supercentenarian Celebrates Her 111th Birthday and a Life Well Lived With Family and Friends
item.description: Surrounded by loved ones, a remarkable supercentenarian marked her 111th birthday with laughter, stories, and gratitude for a life rich in memories. Her celebration was a joyful tribute to resilience, family, and the beauty of growing older.

item.title: She Found a Lost Wallet on the Subway, Not Knowing How Returning it Would Change Her Life
item.description: When she spotted a lost wallet on the subway, she chose to do the right thing and return it, never expecting anything in return. That simple act of honesty set off a chain of events that would change her life in the most unexpected way.

item.title: A Simple Flea Market Visit in Kentucky Leads to an Incredible Family Reunion With the Past
item.description: What started as an ordinary flea market visit in Kentucky turned into a remarkable journey into the past. One unexpected find led to an emotional family reunion and a story generations will never forget.
